# hiok_storage_container (Resource)

A blob container, file share or filesystem in a storage account. File shares can be mapped as a drive (WebDAV) or opened over SFTP.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A file share, mappable as a drive (WebDAV) or reachable over SFTP.
resource "hiok_storage_container" "team" {
  account_id = hiok_storage_account.example.id
  name       = "team"
  kind       = "fileshare"
  quota_gb   = 50
}

output "webdav_url" { value = jsondecode(hiok_storage_container.team.connection_info).webDavUrl }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) The storage account's id.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `access_level` (String) private (default), blob or container.
- `access_tier` (String) hot, cool or archive.
- `default_group` (String) Filesystem: POSIX group of new items.
- `default_mode` (String) Filesystem: mode of new items, e.g. 0644.
- `default_owner` (String) Filesystem: POSIX owner of new items.
- `force_destroy` (Boolean) Delete the container even if it still holds items.
- `kind` (String) blob (default), block, fileshare or filesystem.
- `metadata` (Map of String)
- `protocol` (String) File share protocol label.
- `quota_gb` (Number) For a file share: its size limit.
- `replica_regions` (List of String)
- `versioning_enabled` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `connection_info` (String) For a file share: WebDAV URL, SFTP host and user name.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `item_count` (Number)
- `mount_command` (String) For a file share: how to mount it on Linux.
- `used_bytes` (Number)
